def _runner_line095(cursor):
    code=cursor.f_code;key=(id(code),cursor.f_lasti)
    cached=_runner_line_cache095.get(key)
    if cached is not None:return cached[1]
    line=cursor.f_lineno
    _runner_line_cache095[key]=(code,line)
    return line

def _origin095(frame):
    cursor=frame;origin=None;parent=None
    while cursor is not None:
        if parent is None and id(cursor) in _pending095:parent=_pending095[id(cursor)]
        if cursor.f_code.co_filename.replace('\\','/').lower()==_runner_filename095:
            line=_runner_line095(cursor)
            origin={'runner_line':line,'function':cursor.f_code.co_qualname}
            if line<=len(_source_lines095):origin['source']=_source_lines095[line-1]
            if cursor.f_code.co_name=='<module>':break
        cursor=cursor.f_back
    phase=_phase095
    if parent is not None:phase=parent['phase']
    elif phase=='automatic_control_or_signal' and origin is not None:
        source=origin.get('source','')
        if '.click(' in source or 'click_result(' in source:phase='actual_manual_button'
        elif 'window.calculate(' in source or 'calculate_result(' in source:phase='explicit_direct_calculate'
    return phase,origin
